args.lesson: Semantic checks against the structured source (parse OCDS fields, compare to brief, then manually read regex hits in context) replaced misleading text-presence checks in two EXECs; naive keyword flags ('garanti', ISO date) produced false positives that only context reading resolved. Don't open missions whose success depends on an inbound customer we cannot cause; fold intake readiness into the live demand experiment instead, and spend effort on discovery of the live page.
